resources.string: Move status bar contents without changing its height. Zero restores the original position.
Customize the native button; system rotation proposals, clicks and timeouts are preserved.
Open background notification apps in a window
Notification body clicks open AOSP freeform windows. Foreground apps, calls, alarms and fullscreen notifications keep native behavior. Requires freeform support.
Install or update AOSP Perfect Icons to a version with its adaptive icon index.
ZIP or MTZ with package-name folders containing 0.png (background) and 1.png (foreground). Choose a theme if several exist. No icon artwork is bundled.
Keep original icons for selected apps
Excluded apps retain their native icons, including themed icons.
Imported %1$d icons. The imported library is now selected; enable icon overrides to apply.
